title: Pre-registered test of exact routes under a magnitude-only footprint
status_at_registration: No model output has been computed on any locked image for this test. The construction phase has not been run on the locked set.

locked_set.definition: every malignant image of the selection fold (fold 1) of the frozen split
locked_set.note: Patient-disjoint from the audit cohort and from training. Fold 1 selected the checkpoints by AUROC on unedited images; the test compares controls on the same images, so that use cancels in each difference.

pilot: All pilots used development images of the audit cohort and read no output of the audited checkpoints. (1) On four to six images, contrast targets only: controls holding the target proxy fixed matched the four magnitude descriptors exactly but missed CIELAB dE and the high-frequency change. (2) With this script on three images: a uniform hue control moved the CIELAB contrast by 45 to 120% of the concept edit's own shift, which led to the alternating-hue design registered here; the radial controls missed dE by 0.1 to 1.6% and the high-frequency change by 5 to 75%. (3) The evaluation code was run once on three development images with untrained classification heads, to check the code path only. The pilots are not evidence.
design: Two-by-two: change direction (radial, hue) by patch scale (4, 16 px). A direction pair holds the field and changes the direction; a scale pair holds the direction and changes the field.
response_scale: clipped logit, eta = 1e-6, as in (5) of the main text

analysis_sets.primary: images on which all four controls of the target pass G1 and all three models score the unedited image at >= 0.1
analysis_sets.secondary_independent: the primary images on which all four controls also pass the independent CIELAB check G2
analysis_sets.secondary_all_g1: images on which all four controls of the target pass G1

hypotheses.H_null: Under C1 for M_mag and latent neutrality of the controls, every pairwise difference D of route sums is zero.
hypotheses.decision: Each D is judged by the three-way rule on a simultaneous 95% max-statistic patient bootstrap band over all analysed D components, with margin 0.5 logit; marginal intervals and the frontier of margins are reported alongside.

cell_classes.routes disagree: at least one D of the model-target cell exceeds the margin
cell_classes.routes agree: all four D of the cell are within the margin

hypotheses.construction_failure: a target with fewer than 30 images passing G1 for all three controls is not analysed
hypotheses.expectation: Based on diagnostic (T) on the audit cohort, we expect direction pairs to exceed the margin in most cells. We have no expectation for the scale pairs. The report does not depend on these expectations.

interpretation.routes disagree: rejects the joint package of C1 for M_mag and latent neutrality of the controls; the ladder halts at C1 in the coarse footprint
interpretation.routes agree: the route sum is a candidate concept component for M_mag, conditional on C1 and latent neutrality, which agreement does not prove; theta^C is still not reached because the fixed-level part of C3b fails for edit (7)
interpretation.frontier: the smallest fine-footprint mismatch reachable within these mechanisms; it bounds what these mechanisms can do, not what every control can do
interpretation.direction_vs_scale: a direction pair that exceeds while the scale pairs stay within indicates that the classifier's generic sensitivity depends on the direction of the colour change, which the magnitude-only footprint omits; an exceeding scale pair indicates dependence on the spatial pattern
interpretation.variegation_hue: for the variegation targets the hue controls are expected to fail the independent check, because alternating hue adds colour variety that the RGB proxy, held fixed, does not register; there the direction pairs test C1 jointly with a known neutrality failure, and the scale pairs are the cleaner test

reporting: All registered outcomes will be reported, whatever their direction.
